subject: science
domain: Heredity: Inheritance and Variation of Traits

items.answer: A feature of a living thing, like fur color or height

steps: A trait is a feature such as color or height.
Inherited traits come from the parents.

items.prompt: Why do offspring often look like their parents?

steps: Traits passed from parents make offspring resemble them.

items.answer: Differences in a trait within a group of the same kind of organism

steps: Variation means the trait is not identical in every individual.

items.prompt: Puppies all have floppy ears like their mother. Is floppy ears inherited?

steps: Sharing the parent's trait shows it was inherited.

items.prompt: Sunflowers from one parent are different heights. What is this an example of?

steps: Different heights in the same group show variation.

items.prompt: Name one inherited trait in animals.
items.answer: Fur color (or eye color, ear shape)

steps: Fur color and eye color are inherited traits.

items.prompt: Name one trait that can vary among plants of the same kind.

steps: Height and flower color can vary within a plant group.

items.prompt: Does every individual in a group have the exact same traits?
A chart shows most kittens match a parent's color but a few differ. What two ideas does this show?

steps: Matching shows inheritance; differences show variation.

items.prompt: Explain how a graph of classmates' heights shows variation.
items.answer: The heights range from shorter to taller within the group

steps: A range of heights in a group shows variation.

items.prompt: Two purple-flowered pea plants have mostly purple-flowered offspring. What does this suggest?

steps: Offspring matching the parents suggests the trait was inherited.

items.prompt: Why do puppies from the same litter sometimes look a little different?
items.answer: Because of variation within the group

steps: Variation makes individuals in a group differ slightly.

items.prompt: How can data help show that a trait is inherited?
items.answer: Data showing offspring share the parent's trait is evidence it was inherited

steps: Offspring matching parents in the data supports inheritance.

items.prompt: Describe data you could collect to show variation in a group of plants.
items.answer: Measure and chart the heights of many plants of the same kind

steps: A chart of varying heights shows variation in the group.
